gaps.detail: Generic user IL-12 and VEGF labels remain unresolved. Explicit biological IL12p70 and VEGFA165 are not substituted for unspecified assay analytes.
JCI PDF micro symbols are corrupted in extracted text. Qualitative full-method evidence retained; affected doses unavailable until direct visual verification.
Unique donor counts and cross-arm reuse remain unavailable when not explicitly reported. Technical images/replicates are not people.
No complete source-to-target or cross-omic path constructed. Cell-free binding, phosphorylation, surface abundance, secretion and function are separate records.

synthesis: Twenty narrow assertions across IL13, IL1B, LTA forms, VEGFA165, explicit IL12p70 and IL6/soluble-IL6R contexts. Relevant full Methods and Results recovered for six primary sources. Five ordinary nulls remain inconclusive. Independent all-input hash review is required.
